intents: A Sun* member browses the live kudos board and sees real kudos, highlights, spotlight names and leaderboards from the database
A Sun* member writes and submits a kudo to a colleague, with hashtags, images and links
A Sun* member hearts or un-hearts a colleague's kudo, crediting the sender under the event's multiplier rules
A Sun* member filters the board by hashtag from either dropdown or from a chip on any card
A Sun* member opens a secret box and receives a randomly drawn icon that persists to their profile
